boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-admission activities on campus and around Saratoga Springs, with access details checked against direct sources.

cards.entity_name: Frances Young Tang Teaching Museum and Art Gallery
cards.title: Tang Teaching Museum
cards.subtitle: Skidmore College campus
cards.notes: Meet in the galleries, each pick one work to examine, then compare what you noticed before heading out.
cards.short_summary: Free admission to Skidmore’s teaching museum and art gallery.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tang Teaching Museum states that admission is free; donations are welcome.
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Sunday; its visit page lists current hours and notes closure on Mondays and major holidays.

cards.title: Lucy Scribner Library
cards.subtitle: Skidmore College campus
cards.notes: Bring a book, browse the stacks, or settle into a shared table for a low-key study-and-chat break.
cards.short_summary: A campus library open to the public for on-site use.
cards.evidence_claim: Lucy Scribner Library says it is open to the public and welcomes guests to use print materials on site.
cards.access_notes: Public and guest visitors may use print materials on site; borrowing privileges have separate eligibility rules.

cards.title: North Woods Walk
cards.subtitle: North of Skidmore’s main campus
cards.notes: Use a posted trail map, keep to open paths, and make it a short walking loop with time to pause and listen.
cards.short_summary: A campus forest for walking, hiking, and quiet outdoor time.
cards.evidence_claim: Skidmore describes the North Woods as used by the Skidmore and Saratoga communities for walking, hiking, running, meditation, and skiing.
cards.access_notes: Visitors are invited daily from dawn to dusk; follow posted closures and North Woods rules, including no fires, camping, biking, or littering.

cards.title: Campus Bikeshare Ride
cards.subtitle: Skidmore and Saratoga Springs
cards.notes: Register with a Skidmore email, unlock pedal bikes, and choose a daylight route that ends wherever you can safely lock up.
cards.short_summary: Free pedal-bike rides for College community members.
cards.evidence_claim: Skidmore says its CDPHP Cycle! campus bikeshare is free for people with a Skidmore.edu email, and pedal bikes are free to ride.
cards.access_notes: Requires Skidmore.edu registration and the program app; e-bikes are free only for the first 30 minutes, so choose pedal bikes for a no-cost ride.

cards.title: Schick Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Saisselin Art Building, Skidmore College
cards.notes: Check the exhibition listing, take a slow pass through the gallery, and compare one detail each person would revisit.
cards.short_summary: A Skidmore gallery whose exhibitions and events are free to attend.
cards.evidence_claim: Skidmore states that Schick Art Gallery events are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Solo exhibition of Elgin's work to open at Schick Art Gallery
cards.access_notes: Confirm that an exhibition is on view and check the gallery’s current access details before visiting.

cards.title: Peerless Pool
cards.subtitle: Saratoga Spa State Park
cards.notes: Pack what you need for a swim, arrive during the seasonal pool window, and use the public pool without buying admission.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal public pool with free entry.
cards.evidence_claim: New York State Parks states that entry to Peerless Pool is free.
cards.source_title: New York State Office of Parks Announces Renovated Peerless Pool Complex Opens at Saratoga Spa State Park
cards.access_notes: The State Parks announcement lists free pool entry through September 7, 2026; a vehicle-use fee can apply to drivers during posted hours.

cards.title: Saratoga Spa Trails
cards.subtitle: Saratoga Spa State Park
cards.notes: Pick a walking or biking trail, keep the group together, and leave time to look at the park’s springs and historic landscape.
cards.short_summary: Miles of trails for a self-paced outdoor outing.
cards.evidence_claim: Discover Saratoga identifies Saratoga Spa State Park’s hiking and biking trails as an activity available without spending money.
cards.source_title: Free Things to Do in Saratoga County
cards.access_notes: Park vehicle-entry fees can apply seasonally; walking or biking the trails does not require trail admission. Follow park rules and posted conditions.

cards.entity_name: Historic Congress Park Self-Guided Walking Tour
cards.title: Historic Congress Park Walk
cards.subtitle: Congress Park, Saratoga Springs
cards.notes: Download or pick up the Historic Congress Park tour brochure, then move at your own pace and stop wherever the guide prompts you.
cards.short_summary: A free self-guided route through a named historic park.
cards.evidence_claim: The Saratoga Springs Heritage Area Visitor Center lists Historic Congress Park among its free self-guided walking tours and provides brochures.
cards.access_notes: Tour brochures can be downloaded or collected from the Saratoga Heritage Area Visitor Center; no guided-tour ticket is needed for this self-guided route.

cards.title: Mineral Waters Walking Tour
cards.subtitle: Saratoga Springs
cards.notes: Download the Mineral Waters brochure, choose a few stops rather than rushing the full route, and read the markers together.
cards.short_summary: A free self-guided introduction to Saratoga Springs’ mineral-water sites.
cards.evidence_claim: The Saratoga Springs Heritage Area Visitor Center lists Mineral Waters as one of its free self-guided walking tours.
cards.access_notes: Brochures are available online or at the Saratoga Heritage Area Visitor Center; the route is self-guided and does not require admission.

cards.title: Congress Park Summer Concert
cards.subtitle: War Memorial, Congress Park
cards.notes: Bring a blanket or lawn seat, meet at the War Memorial, and check the current lineup before going for an outdoor evening of music.
cards.short_summary: A family-friendly summer concert series with no admission charge.
cards.evidence_claim: The Saratoga Springs Heritage Area Visitor Center describes the Saratoga Summer Concert Series as free, open to the public, and family-friendly.
cards.source_title: Saratoga Springs Heritage Area Visitor Center Programs and Events
cards.access_notes: Concerts are held at the War Memorial in Congress Park; verify the current season’s dates and rain plan before leaving.
